notes.title: Strange And Mysterious Domain Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’ve released a new update for the [i]Strange And Mysterious Domain[/i] demo. This version focuses on dialogue improvements, a complete UI overhaul, and several critical bug fixes.[/p][h3]Optimizations[/h3][olist][*][p]Polished many story dialogues for smoother narrative flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt all UI interfaces to enhance visuals and interaction.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed misaligned textures in certain objects at the Forest Entrance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pixel-shift errors inside the Detective’s Office.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock issue on the right side outside the Detective’s Office.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could repeatedly obtain unlimited items from the Fisherman.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock during dialogues in Room 301.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misaligned textures in certain objects near the Lake.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain dialogue choices could cause infinite loops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing access to the Apartment Exterior under specific conditions.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you all for your valuable feedback and support. We hope you enjoy exploring the [i]Strange And Mysterious Domain[/i]![/p]
